title: Lớp 11 · Đề Kiểm Tra Giữa Kỳ 1 — Mã Đề 101 (Units 1–3 · 50 Câu)

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose stress or sound is different, or choose the best option.
questions.explanation_vi: develop nhấn âm 2; ba từ còn lại nhấn âm 1.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose stress or sound is different, or choose the best option.
questions.explanation_vi: advice nhấn âm 2; các từ còn lại âm 1.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose stress or sound is different, or choose the best option.
questions.explanation_vi: prevent nhấn âm 2; các từ khác âm 1.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose stress or sound is different, or choose the best option.
questions.explanation_vi: family nhấn âm 1; ba từ còn lại không nhấn âm 1.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose stress or sound is different, or choose the best option.
questions.explanation_vi: equipment nhấn âm 2; các từ khác âm 1.

questions.stem_text: A balanced diet provides the ______ your body needs.
questions.explanation_vi: nutrients: chất dinh dưỡng.

questions.stem_text: My father ______ jogging when he was thirty.
questions.explanation_vi: when he was thirty: mốc quá khứ đã kết thúc.

questions.stem_text: I ______ to the dentist yesterday.
questions.explanation_vi: yesterday dùng quá khứ đơn: went.

questions.stem_text: Linh ______ three health check-ups so far this year.
questions.explanation_vi: so far this year: hiện tại hoàn thành; Linh số ít.

questions.stem_text: They ______ in this neighbourhood since 2019.
questions.explanation_vi: since 2019 chỉ khoảng thời gian kéo dài tới hiện tại.

questions.stem_text: You ______ smoke in a hospital. It is forbidden.
questions.explanation_vi: must not biểu thị cấm; don't have to là không cần.

questions.stem_text: According to the school rules, students ______ wear ID cards.
questions.explanation_vi: have to: nghĩa vụ do nội quy quy định.

questions.stem_text: You ______ share your passwords with strangers. It is unsafe.
questions.explanation_vi: should not: lời khuyên không nên làm việc nguy hiểm.

questions.stem_text: Our grandparents sometimes have different ______ about fashion.
questions.explanation_vi: views: quan điểm.

questions.stem_text: A(n) ______ family may include grandparents, parents and children.
questions.explanation_vi: multigenerational: nhiều thế hệ.

questions.stem_text: The new transport plan sounds ______.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau linking verb sound dùng tính từ practical.

questions.stem_text: I ______ this idea is useful.
questions.explanation_vi: think chỉ quan điểm: dùng hiện tại đơn.

questions.stem_text: Look! The engineers ______ a new bridge design.
questions.explanation_vi: Look! chỉ hành động đang diễn ra.

questions.stem_text: A ______ city uses technology to improve public services.
questions.explanation_vi: smart city: thành phố thông minh.

questions.stem_text: Solar panels produce electricity from ______.
questions.explanation_vi: solar panels dùng ánh sáng mặt trời.

questions.stem_text: The doctor ______ me to do more exercise last week.
questions.explanation_vi: last week: quá khứ đơn.

questions.stem_text: Mai ______ a fitness app since January.
questions.explanation_vi: since January: hiện tại hoàn thành.

questions.stem_text: I ______ three times this week, and I plan another workout tomorrow.
questions.explanation_vi: this week chưa kết thúc; kết quả tính tới hiện tại.

questions.stem_text: My parents and I sometimes ______ about screen-time limits.
questions.explanation_vi: disagree about: bất đồng về.

questions.stem_text: The air smells ______ after the rain.
questions.explanation_vi: Sau linking verb smell dùng tính từ fresh.

questions.stem_text: Mai: “I am trying to eat less sugar.” Nam: “______”
options: That sounds like a healthy choice.
questions.explanation_vi: Phản hồi phù hợp về lựa chọn ăn uống lành mạnh.

questions.stem_text: Son: “Could you tell me why you prefer cycling?” Lan: “______”
options: Because it keeps me active and reduces pollution.
questions.explanation_vi: Câu hỏi Why cần nêu lý do.

questions.stem_text: Dad: “You should get enough sleep before the exam.” Daughter: “______”
options: I agree. I'll go to bed earlier.
questions.explanation_vi: Đáp lại lời khuyên một cách tự nhiên.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: “NO MOBILE PHONES DURING THE TEST.” What does it mean?
options: Only teachers must turn off phones.
Phones can be used for research.
Using phones during the test is prohibited.
questions.explanation_vi: Biển báo cấm sử dụng điện thoại trong giờ kiểm tra.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: “KEEP THE FIRE EXIT CLEAR.” What should people do?
options: Leave the exit free of obstacles.
Use the exit as a storage room.
questions.explanation_vi: Giữ lối thoát hiểm không có vật chắn.

questions.stem_text: SIGN: “QUIET AREA – PLEASE LOWER YOUR VOICE.” What is requested?
questions.explanation_vi: lower your voice: nói nhỏ lại.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “Free health talk: Friday, 4:00 p.m., Room 12. Register by Thursday.” What must students do to attend?
questions.explanation_vi: Đăng ký muộn nhất vào thứ Năm.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “The eco-bus will stop at Gate B instead of Gate A from Monday.” Where should passengers wait on Monday?
questions.explanation_vi: Từ thứ Hai chuyển điểm đón sang Gate B.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “Community workshop: Parents and teens are welcome. Please arrive 15 minutes early.” Which statement is correct?
options: Both parents and teens may attend.
Participants must arrive exactly on time.
questions.explanation_vi: Cả phụ huynh và thanh thiếu niên đều được tham gia.

questions.stem_text: NOTICE: “The rooftop garden is closed today because of strong winds. It will reopen tomorrow if conditions improve.” What can visitors infer?
options: Reopening tomorrow depends on the weather.
It will definitely stay closed all week.
It is closed because of a power cut.
questions.explanation_vi: if conditions improve: mở lại còn phụ thuộc thời tiết.

questions.stem_text: Why did Hoa change her routine?
options: She often felt tired at school.
She wanted to spend more time online.
questions.explanation_vi: Đoạn 1 nêu Hoa thường mệt ở trường.

questions.stem_text: What did Hoa start doing after dinner?
questions.explanation_vi: Đi bộ 20 phút sau bữa tối.

questions.stem_text: How long has Hoa kept her new habits?
questions.explanation_vi: has kept ... for six months.

questions.stem_text: What does Hoa do before bed?
options: She turns off her phone an hour earlier.
questions.explanation_vi: switches it off an hour before bed.

questions.stem_text: What is the main message of the passage?
options: Students should never use a phone.
Small, consistent changes can improve well-being.
Walking is the only form of exercise.
questions.explanation_vi: Ý chính: điều chỉnh thói quen nhỏ đem lại lợi ích.

questions.stem_text: What is the main purpose of Greenfield’s project?
options: To improve local transport and reduce pollution.
questions.explanation_vi: Electric buses và mục tiêu giảm tắc đường, ô nhiễm.

questions.stem_text: How can a passenger without a smartphone check bus times?
options: By using printed timetables at stops.
By asking to borrow the driver’s phone.
questions.explanation_vi: Có bảng giờ in tại mỗi điểm dừng.

questions.stem_text: Why did volunteers offer training sessions?
options: To answer concerns about using the app.
questions.explanation_vi: Giúp người lớn tuổi sử dụng ứng dụng.

questions.stem_text: How long will the council collect feedback?
questions.explanation_vi: three months.

questions.stem_text: Which statement is supported by the passage?
options: The council has already expanded the service.
Only young people may ride the buses.
The town is testing the service before a decision.
questions.explanation_vi: Thu phản hồi trước quyết định mở rộng.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence best preserves the meaning of “It is not necessary for students to buy a new tablet”?
options: Students have to buy a new tablet.
Students do not have to buy a new tablet.
Students must not buy a new tablet.
Students should not buy a new tablet.
questions.explanation_vi: don't have to: không cần thiết, khác must not.

questions.stem_text: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The soup is tasting delicious at the moment.
I think the new eco-plan is useful.
I am knowing the answer now.
questions.explanation_vi: think chỉ quan điểm ở hiện tại đơn.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence means “She began volunteering in 2022 and still does it”?
questions.explanation_vi: Hiện tại hoàn thành với since 2022.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best response. “I often argue with my parents about screen time.”
options: Try listening to their concerns and sharing yours calmly.
You must never talk to them.
questions.explanation_vi: Tư vấn giao tiếp tôn trọng hai chiều.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence uses a linking verb correctly?
options: The air smells freshly this morning.
The new app seems easy to use.
The park looks beautifully after renovation.
questions.explanation_vi: seems + adjective; các đáp án khác dùng trạng từ sai.
